Still, sticking with 3 houses each is probably the better ROI, spending $450 and keeping $529 as a buffer—I can always mortgage or sell houses later if needed. I'm also eyeing unmortgaging Park Place for $220 to work toward the dark blue monopoly once the light blues are set.
